source: BPHS 10th Lord Placement, paraphrased
effect: 10th lord kendra ya trikona me sthit hone se career me leadership, authority aur steady rise ka yog banta hai.

source: Bhavartha Ratnakara 7th House Business Yoga, paraphrased
effect: 7th lord ka 10th ya 11th house se sambandh swatantra vyapar (independent business) aur partnerships me labh deta hai.

source: Classical Budhaditya Yoga principle, paraphrased
effect: Surya aur Budha ka yog (Budhaditya Yoga) buddhimatta, analytical intellect aur administrative roles me safalta deta hai.

source: Jupiter in Kendra/Trikona principle, paraphrased
effect: Guru ka kendra ya trikona me hona career me moral reputation, mentorship aur long-term stability pradan karta hai.

source: Saturn 10th House Karma principle, paraphrased
effect: Shani 10th ya 11th house me hard work, discipline aur 30-36 varsh ke baad mass leadership ya industrial success deta hai.

source: Sun in 10th Digbala principle, paraphrased
effect: Surya 10th house me digbali hota hai, jisse government connections, authority aur public recognition milti hai.

source: Mars in 10th Kuldeepak principle, paraphrased
effect: Mangal 10th house me hone se high energy, executive decision making aur tech/engineering/real estate me uncha pad milta hai.

source: 10th Lord in Dusthana principle, paraphrased
effect: 10th lord dusthana me hone se service roles, foreign business ya occasional professional instability/transfers dekhne ko mil sakte hain.

source: Mercury in 10th or 11th Vyapar principle, paraphrased
effect: Budha vyapar aur communication ka karaka hai; 10th ya 11th me commercial acumen aur agency/IT business me faayda deta hai.

source: Rahu in 10th Modern Business principle, paraphrased
effect: Rahu 10th house me out-of-the-box business ideas, digital/media expansion aur sudden fame pradan kar sakta hai.

source: 10th Lord Exalted principle, paraphrased
effect: 10th lord uccha (exalted) sthiti me hona extraordinary professional growth aur brand value create karta hai.

source: 10th Lord Debilitated principle, paraphrased
effect: 10th lord neecha sthiti me hone par initial career me struggles aur direction clarity pane me samay lagta hai.

source: Running Dasha Lord owning 10th/11th house, paraphrased
effect: Chal rahi Mahadasha ka swami 10th ya 11th ka lord hone se yeh samay career promotions aur business launch ke liye behad anukool hai.

source: Running Dasha Lord owning 6th/8th house, paraphrased
effect: Chal rahi dasha ka lord 6th ya 8th se related ho to naye business me hasty financial risks se bachna chahiye.

source: Aspect of Saturn on 10th House, paraphrased
effect: Shani ki 10th house par drishti career me patience, discipline aur structured planning ki mang karti hai.

source: Aspect of Jupiter on 10th House, paraphrased
effect: Guru ki 10th house par shubh drishti mushkilon se bachati hai aur professional wisdom badhati hai.

source: Venus in 10th Luxury/Creative principle, paraphrased
effect: Shukra 10th me design, arts, luxury goods, hospitality ya public relations ke field me unnati dilata hai.

source: Moon in 10th Public dealing principle, paraphrased
effect: Chandra 10th house me hone se career me public connection, travel aur adaptability badhti hai.

source: 1st Lord in 10th House Swashakti principle, paraphrased
effect: Lagna lord ka 10th house me hona self-made success aur work-driven personality darshata hai.

source: Retrograde Saturn in Career House, paraphrased
effect: Vakri Shani career me strategies ko baar-baar refine karne aur out-of-box hard work se unchai chhoone ka yog banata hai.

source: 9th and 10th Lords Exchange/Connection Dharma-Karmadhipati, paraphrased
effect: 10th lord ka 9th house me hona dharmik aur ethical approach se high career rise deta hai (Dharma-Karma connection).

source: 11th Lord in 10th Income through profession, paraphrased
effect: Labhesh (11th lord) ka Karmesh (10th) me sthiti business se continuous cashflow aur networking labh ka suchak hai.

source: Ketu in 10th Detachment in work, paraphrased
effect: Ketu 10th me traditional hierarchy se alag independent ya technical/research based work me accha perform karwata hai.

source: Jupiter Aspect on 2nd or 11th House, paraphrased
effect: Guru ki 11th house par drishti business profits aur investors ka vishwas mazboot karti hai.

source: Mars-Saturn Conjunction in Kendra, paraphrased
effect: Mangal aur Shani ka kendra me yog high technical capability deta hai, par workplace relationships me patience rakhna zaroori hai.
